# Vista

> Research collective exploring blockchain and AI in Latin America.

## About

Vista is a research and execution team focused on blockchain and AI.
We turn emerging signals into practical strategy and production-ready products.
Based in LATAM. Writing in Spanish and English.

- Website: https://vista.wtf
- Newsletter: https://vistalabs.substack.com
- Telegram: https://t.me/vistawtf
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/vistawtf

## Services

### AI Training
Custom models, fine-tuning LLMs, agent systems for companies entering the AI space.

### Marketing Campaigns
Research-backed go-to-market strategies for blockchain and AI products in LATAM.

### Protocol Growth
Community building, tokenomics, ecosystem growth for crypto protocols.

Contact: vista.wtf/services
